# Senja Fjord Tours

> Private boat tours from Finnsnes — the gateway to Senja, Norway's wildest island.

Senja Fjord Tours offers four private boat experiences departing from Finnsnes harbour, Troms, Norway. All tours are exclusively private — no shared groups. The vessel is a traditional Norwegian sjark.

## Tours

- [Senja Fjord Explorer](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/senja-fjord-explorer/): 6-hour private fjord cruise along Senja's dramatic coastline. Sea eagles, mountain scenery, hidden bays unreachable by road. Year-round.
- [The Fisherman's Haul](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/the-fishermans-haul/): 6-hour hands-on fishing tour — cast lines, haul in the catch, learn to gut and fillet on board. Year-round. Catches not guaranteed.
- [Midnight Sun Cruise](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/midnight-sun-cruise/): 3–4 hour evening voyage under the Arctic midnight sun. Season: late May to mid-July.
- [Northern Lights Cruise](https://www.senjafjordtours.no/northern-lights-cruise/): 3–4 hour winter evening cruise to view the aurora borealis from the water. Season: September to March. Sightings not guaranteed.

## Location

Finnsnes, Troms county, Norway. Approx. 2 hrs by car from Tromsø. Connected to Senja island by the Gisund Bridge.
